_note: Manual sets (artist- or Jules-provided). Applied by lineup.js on every grid tick and after every refresh; never overwritten by scrapers. Date = the night (CT), times 24h CT; a set ending after midnight still belongs to its start night. If a scraped set with the same bar/band/start exists, the scraped row is kept and only its end time is corrected.
